findings.reason: I checked the 木 glyph sequence beneath the headword on PDF page 503 (printed page 490). The scan shows the sequence and script labels, but does not let me independently verify each glyph’s identity. The article and cited explanation identify 木 as a whole-tree pictograph; they do not rely on assigning identities to individual glyphs in this sequence. The unresolved identities therefore do not affect the article’s claims.
